summary.tldr: Requires the federal minister to develop and report on a national strategy to increase employment for persons with disabilities.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Employment and Social Development to develop a national strategy, with provincial employment ministers, to increase the economic participation of persons with disabilities.

Requires the strategy to include steps to educate business owners and private sector employers, correct workplace misconceptions, encourage inclusive hiring, and promote the Opportunities Fund for Persons with Disabilities.
Requires the minister to hold at least one conference with provincial government representatives when developing the strategy.
Requires the minister to table a report on the strategy in both Houses of Parliament within two years of royal assent, then publish it on the department website within 10 days.
Requires the minister to report on the strategy’s effectiveness every five years after the first report is tabled, including conclusions and recommendations.
who_it_affects: Minister of Employment and Social Development
summary.background: The bill says it would create a national employment strategy to increase the economic participation of persons with disabilities.
